title: Latency synthesis histogram + IO-mode split by model & route
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a new dashboard view that synthesizes latency distributions into compact histograms and percentile slices, with a first-class IO-mode (streaming vs non-streaming) split, grouped by model and route. This is intended for platform SREs and product engineers to quickly identify distributional changes (shifts in p50/p95/p99), mode-specific regressions, and coupling to trace spans. The view should be low-cost to query, support rollup windows, and link to trace hooks and sampled logs for root-cause analysis. The dashboard must also enable per-customer SLO slicing and be compatible with both hosted and Dedicated telemetry pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows latency histogram (log-buckets) per model+route with selectable percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and an overlay of current vs baseline
IO-mode toggle splits the panels into streaming vs non-streaming views with synchronized time ranges
Backend query uses precomputed rollups for 1m/5m/1h to avoid excessive cardinality costs
Clicking a histogram bucket or percentile opens linked trace search with relevant trace IDs and KV-cache context
Per-customer SLO slices available as dropdown and reflected in the percentile panels
Latency decomposition panel shows component-level breakdown (frontend overhead, routing, runtime, postprocessing) for selected time range
Dashboard has documentation link and an ops runbook section for common regressions
Performance: panels render within 2s for 30-day window at 5m rollup on common traffic tenants
tasks: Design histogram visualization and UX: decide bucket scheme (log base 2 vs custom) and overlay semantics
Define backend rollup schema: metrics, tags (model, route, io_mode, customer), and retention policy
Implement query layer with sampling-aware corrections to avoid percentile bias
Add trace hook integration points: ensure traces include model+route+io_mode tags and sample IDs
Build dashboard panels in Grafana (or Console UI) with links to trace explorer and logs
Load-test queries on production-like dataset and iterate on rollup intervals to balance cost/latency
Publish docs + runbook and announce to SRE/PM/Platform teams for beta feedback

2025-02-18 - Marco Chen: Implemented backend rollup schema in staging and validated 30d cost estimates; will tune bucket boundaries after design review.
